title: Preserve the trap correction and all instrument histories
statement: Naive continuous return can trap (D_L-D_R)/sqrt(2) at symmetric detuning. The corrected process resolves COMPLETE charge after each short pulse, selects the ACTUALLY observed doublon to resonance and repeats to singly occupied return. With M=2h+d, tau=g/M^2, each actual history has success >=r=(sqrt(2)-.5)^2(g/M)^4. Half-diamond complete-instrument error <=sqrt(p_miss)+p_miss+p_return+(N_c+N_r)delta_Q+eta_phys, retaining source/reference, fine/classical histories and final charge. Loading both isolated-orbital spin modes supplies a singlet; return separates it, discarding one yields an independent mixed spin and retaining it supplies a routing link. Forced teleportation averages five FULL physical pair measurements plus timeout cost. The196056-probe example and physical domain errors remain charged. Existing measurement-only universality is consumed, not rediscovered; overlapping pairs are required.
